_about: One place for facts several components repeat. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/lumebook.py ripple. The dashboard (sites/dashboard/refresh.py) reads this file; tools/lumebook.py check flags copies elsewhere that disagree.

offer._source: Yossi via Yarin, 2026-10-04; corrected 2026-10-07 (no discount code, personal link); 2026-10-08 the number is 25%; 2026-10-11 Yarin confirmed the split mechanics below
offer.allocation_rule: One 25% allocation per sale through the creator's personal link. The creator decides how much of it is their earnings and how much is an audience discount. The discount is applied automatically through the link. It is never 25% earnings plus an extra discount.
offer.commission_wording_he: 25% מכל מכירה דרך הקישור האישי, לחלוקה בין הרווח של היוצר להנחה לקהל (למשל 15% ליוצר ו-10% הנחה)

collaboration_tracks.gift: General: a personalised book in exchange for one agreed video, plus the personal-link arrangement. Commission only, no fee
collaboration_tracks.pro: Professionals: the same offer, written for therapists, parent guides, teachers and other professionals
collaboration_tracks.par: Parents: the same offer, written parent to parent

open_questions: How the sale value behind the 25% is calculated (price only, or shipping too)
How the personal link and its automatic discount are tracked and attributed at checkout
Whether the creator can change their split later

parent_shoot_offer._source: Yarin, 2026-10-14. Separate from the creator offer (offer): families, not creators.
parent_shoot_offer.name_en: Home shooting day for social media, for a free book
parent_shoot_offer.wording_he: יום צילום לרשתות החברתיות של לומבוק, אצלכם בבית, תמורת ספר מותאם אישית במתנה
parent_shoot_offer.who_on_camera: the child (face visible) and a parent, with the book
parent_shoot_offer.posts_on: LumeBook's socials; the parent does not need to post or have followers
parent_shoot_offer.compensation: one free personalised book, the full compensation
parent_shoot_offer.eligibility: parent or legal guardian of every child on camera; children aged 1 to 10
parent_shoot_offer.base: Ashkelon, by public transport, closest families first
